title: RoSeViT: Role-Separated Vision Transformers for ARC Visual Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2601.13562v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: ARC tasks can be formulated as visual transformation problems, where a model must infer a high-level transformation rule from a small set of demonstrations and apply it consistently across a grid. While dense Vision Transformers (ViTs) perform well in this setting, they entangle local visual state and global transformation logic within a shared token representation, which can hinder consistent reasoning. In this paper, we introduce RoSeViT, a role-separated Vision Transformer that explicitly decouples high-level instruction inference from visual workspace computation. RoSeViT uses controller tokens to aggregate transformation-level information and workspace tokens to represent the visual grid, with a structured attention pass in which nonlocal workspace interactions are routed through the controller. translated_title: RoSeViT：用于ARC视觉推理的角色分离视觉Transformer
translated_abstract: ARC任务可以被形式化为视觉变换问题，模型需要从少量示例中推断出高层变换规则，并将其一致地应用于整个网格。虽然密集视觉Transformer（ViT）在此类任务中表现良好，但它们在共享的token表示中纠缠了局部视觉状态与全局变换逻辑，这可能阻碍一致的推理。在本文中，我们提出了RoSeViT，一种角色分离的视觉Transformer，它显式地将高层指令推断与视觉工作区计算解耦。RoSeViT使用控制器token来聚合变换级别的信息，并使用工作区token来表示视觉网格，同时采用一种结构化的注意力传递机制，使非局部的工作区交互通过控制器进行路由。这一设计的动机来自我们的形式化分析，该分析表明强制使用共享指令表示会降低有效通信能力。
tldr: RoSeViT通过控制器token与工作区token的角色分离设计，将高层指令推断与视觉工作区计算显式解耦，从而提升ARC视觉推理任务中规则应用的一致性和性能。
en_tdlr: RoSeViT introduces a role-separated Vision Transformer that decouples high-level instruction inference from visual workspace computation via controller and workspace tokens, enabling more consistent reasoning on ARC visual transformation tasks.
